Heme 
Metabolism
Heme is oxidized to biliverdin, which is then reduced
to bilirubin; bilirubin is transported to the liver where it 
is converted to bilirubin diglucuronide to be excreted
with the bile pigments
Storage
Storage of glycogen, fats, fatty acids, and fat-soluble 
vitamins
